cover.creator: <Creator>
cover.statistics_note: Clawbot.Agents.Core.Chat, Clawbot.Agents.Core.Content, Clawbot.Domain.ChatScenarios, Clawbot.SharedKernel.Content, Clawbot.Agents.Core.Orchestrator, Clawbot.Domain.KnowledgeBase, Clawbot.Domain.Conversations, Clawbot.Infrastructure.Security, Clawbot.Infrastructure.Content.Publishing, Clawbot.Domain.Leads, Clawbot.SharedKernel.Security

environment:
1. Windows 11 + .NET 8 SDK
2. SQL Server 2022 (Docker :1433)
3. Redis 7 (Docker :6379)
4. xUnit + FluentAssertions
5. Moq (DNS stub via LlmBaseUrlGuard.ResolveHostAddresses test seam)

methods.requirement: Guard outbound LLM provider URLs against SSRF: reject non-http/https schemes, embedded credentials, public cleartext HTTP, and private hosts without explicit operator grant. Fail closed when DNS resolves to a mix of public and private addresses or when resolution fails.
methods.description: Validate a base URL before an outbound HttpClient is created for an LLM provider
methods.precondition: The DNS test seam (LlmBaseUrlGuard.ResolveHostAddresses) is replaced with a stub in test setup

groups.label: DNS stub
values: returns mix: one public + one private address

methods.requirement: The AesEncryptor constructor must reject missing, malformed, or wrong-length base64 keys with a clear InvalidOperationException before any encryption call can be made.
methods.description: Validate the Encryption:Base64Key option when AesEncryptor is constructed via DI
methods.precondition: AesEncryptor is constructed directly using OptionsWrapper<EncryptionOptions>

groups.label: Base64Key option
values: valid base64 but decodes to 16 bytes (wrong length)
valid base64 but decodes to 64 bytes (wrong length)
valid base64 that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

groups.label: Outcome
values: Constructor succeeds; Encrypt returns a non-empty base64 string
InvalidOperationException is thrown with a descriptive message

methods.requirement: Deterministic pre-LLM lint: reject content bodies that contain absolute outcome guarantees, external links or junk encoding characters. Pass empty/whitespace bodies and clean bodies unchanged.
methods.description: Static content lint that runs before the LLM reviewer gate

groups.label: body
values: body with tab and newline only (allowed control chars)
body containing an absolute-guarantee phrase (prohibited commitment)
body containing "100% do" (absolute guarantee phrase, uppercase variant)

methods.requirement: Return the best-matching ChatScenario for an inbound text. Regex trigger scores 1000 + match.Length; substring scores trigger.Length. Tiebreak: higher SuccessRate then lower Code. Platform CSV filter: empty or 'all' matches any platform.
methods.description: Pure scenario selector used by the auto-reply pipeline to pick the correct response template
methods.precondition: No external dependencies; pure function with in-memory candidate list

groups.label: text
values: text matching one scenario via regex
text matching two scenarios; one has longer regex match (more specific)
text matching two scenarios; equal score; one has higher SuccessRate
text matching two scenarios; equal score and rate; one has lower Code (ordinal)

groups.label: candidates
values: single scenario, no platform filter (platforms empty)

methods.requirement: Return the next golden-hour slot in UTC+7 for a given platform. Known platforms: facebook=20:30, tiktok=20:00, instagram=19:30, youtube=18:00, zalo=08:00. Unknown platform defaults to 19:00. If the candidate slot has already passed today, return the same slot tomorrow.
methods.description: Calculates the next optimal posting time per platform for the content scheduler

groups.label: utcNow (Vietnam time context)
values: before the platform golden hour today (e.g. 10:00 VN for facebook 20:30)
after the platform golden hour today (e.g. 21:00 VN for facebook 20:30)
exactly at the platform golden hour (boundary)

groups.label: Return
values: today's golden hour in UTC+7 (converted to UTC)
tomorrow's golden hour in UTC+7 (converted to UTC)

methods.requirement: NextRunUtc advances a UTC timestamp by one cadence unit in the given timezone. WindowKey returns a deterministic string key for the cadence window (e.g. weekly:2026-W33, quarterly:2026-Q3). Month-end dates are clamped to the last valid day of the target month.
methods.description: Recurrence engine used by AgentSchedules to compute the next run time and deduplicate runs within a window
methods.precondition: Timezone ID must be a valid IANA/Windows timezone (e.g. SE Asia Standard Time)

groups.label: fromUtc / dueAtUtc
values: Jan 31 (month end, +1 month → Feb should clamp to Feb 28)
last day of a quarter (e.g. Sep 30 for Q3)

groups.label: Return
values: window key string matching expected format

methods.requirement: IsAutoApprovable returns true only when: Status=pending, Verdict=approve, both accuracy values present, accuracy_after >= accuracy_before. Approve(auto) requires IsAutoApprovable=true and no decidedBy. Approve(human) requires a decidedBy userId. Reject requires a non-empty reason string.
methods.description: Domain aggregate methods controlling the KB suggestion lifecycle
methods.precondition: KbSuggestion instance built via KbSuggestion.Create with valid parameters

methods.requirement: PauseAiAutoReplyUntil sets enabled=false and records resumeAt. TryResumeAiAutoReply returns true and clears resumeAt only when enabled=false AND resumeAt <= now. SetAiAutoReply(false) is a permanent toggle (clears resumeAt). Escalate sets enabled=false with resumeAt=null permanently.
methods.description: AI auto-reply state machine on the Conversation aggregate
methods.precondition: Conversation instance is in a valid state (not resolved/deleted)

groups.label: Return / side-effect
values: enabled=false; resumeAt set to the given future time

methods.requirement: Reject an orchestration plan before any agent runs: empty plan, task count above MaxTaskCount (50), missing or duplicate task id, task input above MaxTaskInputChars (8192), agent not present in the orchestratable catalog, dangling dependency, and dependency cycle. Fail closed with a machine-readable error code.
methods.description: Validate a planner-produced plan document against the bound agent catalog
methods.precondition: A catalog is supplied with at least one entry where Orchestratable is true

groups.label: plan.Tasks
values: two tasks with the same Id (different casing)
one task, input total length 8193 chars
two tasks, second DependsOn an unknown id
two tasks forming a dependency cycle
three tasks in a valid dependency chain

groups.label: catalog entry Orchestratable
values: false (agent exists but is not orchestratable)

methods.requirement: Block an orchestration run when the month-to-date spend plus the estimate would exceed the tenant cap. Treat a negative estimate as zero. Prefer the reservation store when the tracker implements it. Always write a ledger entry when there are tokens, even when the computed cost is zero, so the monthly cap cannot silently lose data.
methods.description: Enforce the per-tenant monthly LLM cost cap before and during an orchestration run
methods.precondition: A fake ILlmCostTracker returns a controlled SummaryAsync result; a separate fake also implements ILlmCostReservationStore

groups.label: reply tokens / cost
values: cost 0 but input tokens above zero (provider returned no usage rate)

groups.label: Outcome
values: Allowed is true, Reason is null
Allowed is true with the store ReservationId propagated
RecordAsync writes one CostEntry to the tracker

methods.requirement: Only allow HTTPS URLs that resolve exclusively to public addresses before media is handed to a social platform. Reject non-HTTPS schemes, embedded credentials, loopback and .local or .localhost names, RFC-1918 and shared-address ranges, IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback, link-local and site-local IPv6, documentation prefixes, DNS failures and resolution timeouts.
methods.description: Validate a public media URL before it is submitted to an external publishing API
methods.precondition: A stub IHostAddressResolver is injected; the resolution timeout is shortened for the timeout case

methods.requirement: Fail closed when parsing a reviewer verdict. Check the completion envelope first (terminal success, refusal, content filter, truncation, finish reason), then require the whole trimmed output to be exactly one closed-schema JSON object. Reject prose, code fences, trailing tokens, unknown fields, duplicate keys, an unknown verdict and a reason exceeding the length limit. The vision path additionally requires reviewedPartIds to match the requested and sent part ids exactly.
methods.description: Parse a content reviewer completion into an accepted verdict or a machine-readable error code
methods.precondition: ReviewCompletionEnvelope is constructed directly in the test; no LLM call is made

groups.label: RawText
values: a fenced code block containing JSON
a valid object followed by a trailing token
an object with an unknown extra field
an object with verdict repeated twice
a valid object with a reason above the length limit

groups.label: part ids (vision path)
values: requested, sent and reviewed all match

methods.requirement: The default rule set is the contract between the seed-defaults endpoint and the message classifier event codes. Every event code emitted by the classifier must have exactly one rule, weights must match the agreed values, and no code may be duplicated. purchase_intent must outweigh every other single signal.
methods.description: Confirm the default lead-scoring rule table stays in sync with the classifier event codes
methods.precondition: None; the rule table is a static readonly collection

groups.label: assertion target
values: every rule has a non-empty description

groups.label: Expected
values: purchase_intent weight is strictly greater than all others
description length is above zero for every rule

methods.requirement: Code is the single source of truth for auth timing. The API JwtOptions and the Infrastructure RefreshTokenOptions and Identity lockout all PostConfigure from these constants, so a stray appsettings value cannot drift the access-token lifetime, clock skew, refresh window or lockout out of sync. The Gateway is isolated by ADR-007 and must carry an identical ClockSkewSeconds in its own configuration.
methods.description: Lock auth timing constants and confirm bound options match after PostConfigure
methods.precondition: A host is built with a deliberately wrong appsettings value for each option under test

groups.label: Expected
values: bound option equals the constant, appsettings is ignored
